name: Insect Part Analysis

meta.next: Rise of the Silithid (Alliance), Rise of the Silithid (Horde)

summary: From Tanaris, Alchemist Pestlezugg sends an urgent warning to Gadgetzan. The danger threatens both places and may spread across southern Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Grave Warning
sections.body:
Alchemist Pestlezugg asks you to carry the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan. The danger threatens Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and may spread across southern Kalimdor. It could reach all of Azeroth, and nothing suggests it will subside. Pestlezugg wants everyone who can read to know.

Fizzledowser is to make a duplicate for you, so you can share it freely with your allegiance.

sections.title: A Matter of Coin
sections.body:
Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser thanks you for bringing the report and for your hard work for the Gadgetzan Water Company. The company holds valuable information, and Fizzledowser would usually expect people to pay well for it.

But Fizzledowser has known Alchemist Pestlezugg for a long time. Pestlezugg recommends sharing the report with everyone, so Fizzledowser agrees and makes a copy for you.

faq.q: Who sends the report and who receives it?
aliases: who do i turn insect part analysis in to
faq.answer: Alchemist Pestlezugg gives you the report to take to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Why is Alchemist Pestlezugg so alarmed?
aliases: what is in the insect report
why is the insect threat serious
faq.answer: Pestlezugg warns that the threat faces Tanaris and Gadgetzan, then may reach all of southern Kalimdor and perhaps all of Azeroth. Nothing suggests it will subside.

faq.q: Why do you need a copy of the report?
faq.answer: Pestlezugg wants everyone to know about the threat. Fizzledowser is to make a duplicate for you to share freely with your allegiance.

faq.q: What comes directly before this delivery?
faq.answer: This delivery follows an earlier step with the same name.
